data.revised_prompt: Create a more customer-friendly version of the reference for a real Guochao opera styling experience store. Keep the same 16:9 storefront/studio composition and xiqu headwear silhouette, but reduce theatricality: the main model should look like a stylish young customer after professional Guochao styling, not a stage performer. Headwear remains inspired by traditional opera: blue-white floral bead crown, pearl tassels, black sculpted hair patches, small red pom-poms. Makeup is simplified modern beauty makeup: clear natural base, soft peach-pink eye makeup, fine eyeliner, clean red lip, no white mask, no thick black theatrical paint, no exaggerated contour. Outfit: short youthful Chinese jacket with cloud-collar edge and pankou, sheer sleeve panels, straight pants or culotte shorts, light and wearable. Background boutique: red brick, warm wood, brass shelves, headwear display, mirror lights. Bright, fresh, Chinese Guochao, 16-35 friendly.
